documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our partner support team requested discovery about manual status updates. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our partner support team requested discovery about manual status updates. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that there may be some confusion regarding the current status of your project. Could you please clarify whether the project is currently paused and if there are any disagreements about the requirement for manual status updates? This will help us ensure we are aligned before scheduling a discovery meeting.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
questions: Are there any disagreements about the requirement for manual status updates?
uncertainties: The project status is unclear and needs clarification before moving forward.
